title: Confinement and chiral symmetry breaking in holography: a smooth switch-off
summary: We revisit the holographic description of the thermal first order phase transition of N=4 SYM compactified on a spatial circle. At the transition, the dominant bulk saddle exchanges between a geometry with a compact spatial circle and one with a compact Euclidean time circle. We construct a one-parameter family of Euclidean geometries that describes the unstable branch of the transition, completing the swallow-tail structure of the free energy.
